# Minima Vue

Minima Vue is a Vue 3 component system for admin extensions and standalone applications.

This file is the concise LLM context index for this repository. For detailed API and component internals, use `llms-full.txt`.

## Repository Identity

- Monorepo root package: `minima-vue3`
- Workspaces: icons, toolbox, ui-preset, ui, docs, dashboard
- Docs brand: `Minima Vue` (see `docs/src/data/site.ts`)

## Workspace Packages

- `@minima-vue/ui` (path: `ui`) - Minima Vue components for Vue 3
- `@minima-vue/icons` (path: `icons`) - Minima Vue icon library
- `@minima-vue/ui-preset` (path: `ui-preset`) - Minima Vue UI preset
- `@minima-vue/toolbox` (path: `toolbox`) - CLI tool for importing Figma designs for Minima Vue
- `@minima-vue/docs` (path: `docs`) - Documentation app
- `@minima-vue/dashboard` (path: `dashboard`) - Dashboard app

## Core Installation Patterns

### Standalone Vue Project

1. Install:
- `npm install @minima-vue/ui @minima-vue/icons`
- `npm install -D @minima-vue/ui-preset`

2. Tailwind v3 config essentials:
- Add `@minima-vue/ui-preset` to `presets`
- Include `./node_modules/@minima-vue/ui/dist/**/*.{js,mjs}` in `content`

3. Runtime style import:
- `import "@minima-vue/ui/style.css"`

### Admin Extension

- Use `@minima-vue/ui` and `@minima-vue/icons` in extension packages.
- For token/icon generation workflows, use `@minima-vue/toolbox`.

## Main UI Surface

- Components: 42 documented components
- Composables: `useToggleState`, `usePrompt` (currently throws), `useToast` + `toast`
- Utilities: `clx`, `calendar`, `isBrowserLocaleHourCycle24h`, `isInputElement`

## Docs Route Groups

- Introduction: `/`
- Installation: `/installation/medusa-admin-extension`, `/installation/standalone-project`
- Icons: `/icons/overview`
- Colors: `/colors/overview`
- Components: `/components/<slug>`
- Hooks: `/hooks/use-prompt`, `/hooks/use-toggle-state`
- Utils: `/utils/clx`

## Common Commands

- `dev`: `npm run dev --workspace @minima-vue/docs`
- `dev:docs`: `npm run dev --workspace @minima-vue/docs`
- `dev:dashboard`: `npm run dev --workspace @minima-vue/dashboard`
- `generate:docs`: `npm run generate --workspace @minima-vue/docs`
- `changeset`: `changeset`
- `version-packages`: `changeset version`
- `release`: `changeset publish`
- `build:packages`: `npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/toolbox && npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/icons && npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/ui-preset && npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/ui`
- `pack:packages`: `npm pack --workspace @minima-vue/toolbox && npm pack --workspace @minima-vue/icons && npm pack --workspace @minima-vue/ui-preset && npm pack --workspace @minima-vue/ui`
- `publish:packages`: `npm publish --workspace @minima-vue/toolbox && npm publish --workspace @minima-vue/icons && npm publish --workspace @minima-vue/ui-preset && npm publish --workspace @minima-vue/ui`
- `build:docs`: `npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/docs`
- `build:dashboard`: `npm run build --workspace @minima-vue/dashboard`
- `build`: `npm run build:packages && npm run build:docs && npm run build:dashboard`
